crossRefs.note: Then I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, there stood before the river a ram which had two horns. The two horns…

translations.web: He came to the ram that had the two horns, which I saw standing before the river, and ran on him in the fury of his power.
translations.bsb: He came toward the two-horned ram I had seen standing beside the canal and rushed at him with furious power.
translations.kjv: And he came to the ram that had two horns, which I had seen standing before the river, and ran unto him in the fury of his power.
translations.asv: And he came to the ram that had the two horns, which I saw standing before the river, and ran upon him in the fury of his power.
